title: Scalar Curvature, Volumes and the Bergman Kernel
summary: Motivated by the works of Gromov and LeBrun in Riemannian geometry, we study the analogous phenomena in complex geometry. We first show that both $\int_M |S_C^-(g)|^ndV_g$ and ${\rm vol}_g(M)$ (normalized by $S_C(g)\ge -1$) are bounded below by $\frac{(nπ)^n}{n!}\mathrm{CanVol}(M)$ for any Hermitian metric $g$ on a compact complex $n-$manifold $M$. Here $S_C$ denotes the Chern scalar curvature, $S_C^-=\max\{-S_C,0\}$ and ${\rm CanVol}(M)$ is the canonical volume of $M$, i.e., the volume of the canonical line bundle $K_M$.
